changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.20[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: Offcloud[/COLOR]
-Offcloud joins Real-Debrid,Premiumize,Easynews,AllDebrid and TorBox as a debrid service of its own: Settings > Accounts > Offcloud.
-Authorize Offcloud opens the sign-in window with a QR code and a code to enter at offcloud.com/activate. If Offcloud does not give a code, or you prefer it, "Authorize Offcloud with an API key" takes the API key of your Offcloud account.
-Searches ask Offcloud which torrents it already has and list them as cached, alone or together with your other debrid services. Offcloud has its own priority, like the others.
-Cached torrents play at once, straight from Offcloud, without being added to your Offcloud cloud. For an episode, the right file is picked from a season pack; samples and extras are left out, and full Blu-ray discs (.m2ts) are skipped.
-Browse Debrid Pack, Save to Cloud and, for uncached torrents, Cache to Cloud work as with the other services. An uncached torrent is never left downloading in your cloud unless you ask for it.
-Offcloud cloud: My Services > Offcloud lists what is in your cloud, opens each folder, plays and downloads its files and removes items. With "Enable cloud scraper" on, what you already have in your Offcloud cloud shows up in the source list.
-If Offcloud does not answer the cache check, its torrents are still listed as unchecked and checked when you play them. If Offcloud no longer accepts the sign-in, you are told once and its torrents are left out until you authorize it again.
-Offcloud has its colour in the source list, its official logo in the menus and notifications, the sign-in window, the account status window and Sync your devices, its row in the Debrid Hub, and its days left in the status of your accounts. Sync your devices can send the Offcloud sign-in to your other devices.
-The Offcloud sign-in is blanked out in the sanitized copy of kodi.log (Write a sanitized copy of kodi.log).
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Source Results: Browse Debrid Pack did not open anything and Save to Cloud always answered "No cloud transfer available", with every debrid service. Both now reach the right service.
-My Services: the TorBox entry read "Enable TorBox Menu". It now reads TorBox.
